title: Our mighty mother!
html_source:
Courtesy of UMT English Dept.:

“Our mighty mother!” This phrase, so similar to the Algy(Swimburne) phrase he has just used, comes from a different writer, the Irishman George Russell, known by the pen name AE. Thornton cites many appearances of the phrase in Russell’s writings, and notes that it refers to “the physical world, or, more specifically, the Earth.” Gifford defines the Mighty Mother as “nature in its spiritual aspect.”
